news.title: 1 dead, 2 injured after fire at DeKalb County home, officials say
news.summary: One person is dead, and two others are injured after a heavy fire tore through a three-story home on Lake Drive in DeKalb County on Saturday night, according to fire officials.

news.title: House fire claims life in Snellville, 2 injured
news.summary: A person was found dead in a house fire in DeKalb County, and the two other residents of the home were hurt Saturday night.

news.title: Former halfway house worker sentenced for assaulting federal inmate
news.summary: A former employee at an Atlanta federal halfway house was sentenced to 18 months in prison for sexually assaulting an inmate in his custody and lying to investigators, according to federal prosecutors

news.title: Man arrested after stray bullet hits boy in southeast Atlanta, police say
news.summary: A man is in custody after a stray bullet from a neighborhood dispute hit a young boy late Friday night in the Ormewood Park neighborhood, according to police.

news.title: Wanted man arrested in deadly Clayton County gas station shooting
news.summary: Authorities have arrested a homicide suspect wanted in connection with a deadly shooting at a Clayton County gas station earlier this month, police announced Saturday.
